goals.title: build the dashboard
goals.why: Find and ship one real, verifiable improvement to `atris-cli` per overnight tick — bug fix, UX polish, or doc/code drift correction. Push immediately. Don't sit on green commits.
acceptance: One bounded next move is proposed from MISSION.md, not hand-fed by the human.
The move has verifier/proof target, stop rule, and human-ask condition.
A receipt or log entry records what changed and what remains uncertain.
